basic_details.job_title: ICAR-CMFRI Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Research Assistant, Field Assistant Posts
basic_details.short_information: ICAR-Central Marine Fisheries Research Institute (ICAR-CMFRI), Kochi, will engage one Research Assistant (Rs. 25,000 per month) and one Field Assistant/Technical Assistant (Rs. 20,000 per month, consolidated) for the project "Comprehensive mapping and impact assessment of invasive species along the coastline of Kerala". Both posts are purely on contract for one year from joining or till the project ends, whichever is earlier. Eligible candidates must submit biodata and scanned documents through the Google Form by 19 November 2026; the offline walk-in interview is on 26 November 2026 at 10.00 A

age_limit.details: For both posts the age limit is below 35 years as on the date of notification. Age relaxation is available as per Government guidelines; the notice gives no category-wise figures. | For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should check the official notification.

how_to_apply: Open the Google Form given in the notice and submit your biodata along with scanned copies of the original supporting documents by 19.11.2026.

Send all original certificates from matriculation onwards in scanned form through the same Google Form on or before 19.11.2026. Without these certificates, applicants will not be allowed to appear for the interview.

Complete Annexure-I (the application format) and Annexure-II (the declaration), both duly signed, and submit them through the Google Form on or before 19.11.2026. Annexure-I has space for a passport size photograph.

If any near or distant relative is an employee of ICAR-CMFRI, declare the name, designation, nature of duties and relationship in writing in Annexure-II and communicate it through the Google Form on or before 19.11.2026.
Wait for the e-mail: shortlisted candidates are intimated by e-mail, and only those who receive the communication may appear for the walk-in interview on the specified date and time.
Name in block letters, father's/husband's name, category (SC/ST/OBC/General), date of birth, age as on 01.11.2026, gender.
Correspondence and permanent addresses, e-mail ID and mobile numbers.
Educational qualification from 10th class onwards, with marks given in percentage.
Working/professional experience, current employment elsewhere (with NOC), research papers and achievements, desirable experience for the post, relatives at ICAR/CMFRI, and a signed self-declaration.
Biodata and scanned copies of all original certificates from matriculation onwards.
One valid ID proof, to be produced at the time of interview.
No Objection Certificate from the present employer, if any.
Approved conversion table/formula for marks issued as CGPA/OGPA, to be produced at reporting for the interview.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for appearing for the interview. Concealing facts or canvassing in any form shall lead to disqualification or termination. The competent authority has the right to terminate without assigning any reason at any time. If a candidate's marks are in CGPA/OGPA and no approved conversion table/formula is produced at reporting, the candidature will not be considered. If a relative's employment at ICAR/CMFRI is communicated or declared only on the interview date, the candidate will not be interviewed. Selected candidates shall not claim any regular appointment at the institute. The decision of the Director, ICAR-CMFRI is final and binding in all respects.

content_sections.heading: About ICAR-CMFRI
content_sections.text: ICAR-Central Marine Fisheries Research Institute is based at Kochi and is the place of work for both posts. The positions are attached to a project on mapping invasive species and assessing their impact along the Kerala coastline. The notice is signed by the project's PI.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications for two posts in total, one Research Assistant and one Field Assistant/Technical Assistant. It says the total number of vacancies may vary depending on other project requirements, if any, on the date of interview. No category-wise break-up is printed.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Identification of marine organisms, including marine plankton and benthos, and experience in water and sediment quality analysis and data analysis. Working knowledge of GIS and remote sensing tools such as QGIS, ArcGIS and Google Earth Engine. Swimming/diving experience and willingness to travel to various locations for field sampling and data collection. Postgraduate in Fisheries Science/ Marine Biology/ Marine Science/ Environmental Science/Zoology. Identification of marine organisms, including marine plankton and benthos, and experience in water and sediment quality analysis and data analysis. Working knowledge of GIS and remote sensing tools such as QGIS, ArcGIS and Google Earth Engine. Swimming/diving experience and willingness to travel to various locations for field sampling and data collection. For both posts the age limit is below 35 years as on the date of notification. Age relaxation is available as per Government guidelines; the notice gives no category-wise figures. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Both posts carry consolidated emoluments: Rs. 25000/- per month for the Research Assistant and Rs. 20000/- per month for the Field Assistant/Technical Assistant. Each post is purely on a contract basis for one year from the date of joining or till termination of the project, whichever is earlier. The notice calls the positions contractual, non-regular, time bound and co-terminus with the project.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in ICAR-CMFRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 posts: one Research Assistant and one Field Assistant/Technical Assistant. The notice says the total may vary depending on other project requirements, if any, on the date of interview.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the Google Form?
faq.answer: The Google Form with biodata, scanned certificates and signed declarations must be submitted on or before 19 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. When is the ICAR-CMFRI walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The offline walk-in interview is on 26 November 2026 at 10.00 AM at ICAR-Central Marine Fisheries Research Institute, Kochi. Only candidates who receive an e-mail communication may appear.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Research Assistant?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is Postgraduate in Fisheries Science/Marine Science/Marine Biology/Zoology.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for Field Assistant/Technical Assistant?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is Graduates in Fisheries Science/ Marine Science/ Marine Biology/ Zoology/ Botany. A postgraduate degree in Fisheries Science, Marine Biology, Marine Science, Environmental Science or Zoology is desirable.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for ICAR-CMFRI Research Assistant and Field Assistant posts?
faq.answer: The age limit is below 35 years as on the date of notification for both posts. Age relaxation is available as per Government guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: The Research Assistant gets Rs. 25000/- per month and the Field Assistant/Technical Assistant gets Rs. 20000/- per month, both as consolidated emoluments.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. Both posts are purely on a contract basis for one year from the date of joining or till termination of the project, whichever is earlier, and the selected candidates cannot claim any regular appointment.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for appearing for the interview.

faq.question: Q10. What must a candidate with a relative at ICAR-CMFRI do?
faq.answer: Such a candidate must declare the relative's name, designation, nature of duties and relationship in writing as in Annexure-II and communicate it through the Google Form on or before 19 November 2026.
